Ava (CS): Heads up — I had a convo with Sam (DataWave) about an expansion opportunity, copying you all for triage.
Sam (DataWave): We're planning to onboard 3 teams (Support, Search, Analytics) over ~6 weeks. New use case: agent-assisted support summarization + internal semantic search. Baseline expectation: 30 req/s steady, peak ~120 req/s during business hours. Avg request ~150 tokens; embeddings requests ~1k/min for reindexing. Renewal is Q4 — could be an uplift.
Priya (AE): Thanks — looping in @Marco (SE) and @Lily (Onboard) to scope technical and enablement needs. We'll schedule a sync with Sam.
Marco (SE): Quick q: are requests evenly distributed or bursty? Any hourly heatmaps? For a rough calc: 100 req/s * 150 tokens = 15k tokens/s -> ~54M tokens/hr. Hosted plan could exceed quotas/costs quickly. Can you paste a sample hourly breakdown?
Sam (DataWave): here's a quick profile:
```
{ "hourly_peak": 120, "hourly_median": 30, "payload_avg_tokens": 150, "peak_window_minutes": 90 }
```
Marco (SE): Perfect — I'll run a capacity + cost estimate and model recommendations (quantized variants + batching). Also will evaluate Dedicated (reserved capacity) vs Hosted tiers. Expect a short recommendation doc by EOD tomorrow.
Lily (Onboard): I can run a 60-min enablement workshop per team and produce starter playbooks + runbooks. Recommend kicking off with Support team (they'll drive early wins).
Ava (CS): Priya — can you coordinate the renewal touchpoint? This looks like an easy upsell but we should lock commercial terms early.
Priya (AE): On it. I'll set a renewal/upsell meeting with Sam for Tue 10am PT and create a renewal ticket, tagging GTM & finance.
Marco (SE): Possible mitigation ops: prefix/KV caching + request dedupe for support summarization flows — that could shave ~25–35% of token ops depending on prompt reuse. Also consider batching + lower-precision quantized model for analytics requests.
Ava (CS): Great. Sam — we'll follow up with: (1) capacity plan + cost estimate, (2) proposed pricing for hosted vs dedicated, (3) enablement schedule. :thumbsup:
Sam (DataWave): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
deploy-bot: No deploys affecting customer capacity in the past 48h.
Ava (CS): Closing loop — I'll drop the action items into the shared doc and send invites.
